identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Hydro-Technical' aesthetic that fuses the fluidity of water with the precision of engineering.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix water aesthetics with industrial precision.
Emotion First: Evoke trust, cleanliness, and reliability.
Content is King: Data and photos are the heroes.
Zoom In: Focus on details (pH levels, clear water).
Negative Space: Use white space to represent cleanliness.

headings.usage: All section headers, page titles, and modal titles. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: All paragraph text, labels, inputs, and data tables.

mono.usage: Technical data (pH readings, chemical amounts, IDs).

typography.installation: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.

primary.name: Electric Azure
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key icons.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, modal overlays, floating action buttons.
glassmorphism.classes: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 shadow-sm

textures.water_overlay: Use a subtle noise texture or the water image with low opacity (5%) on the login background.

buttons.style: Solid colors, no gradients. Sharp corners or slightly rounded (rounded-md).

cards.style: Flat white background with subtle border (border-slate-100).
cards.interaction: Hover state should lift slightly and darken border.

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all

navigation.mobile: Bottom tab bar for technicians. Large icons (24px+).

hero_backgrounds.description: Clear blue water in a modern swimming pool. Use for Login Page background or Customer Portal Hero.
Abstract swirls of blue and purple with bubbles. Use for decorative cards or empty states.

technicians.description: Person cleaning filter. Use for 'Service History' or 'Job Details' examples.
Pool with life preserver. Use for safety checklists or general maintenance imagery.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Avoid full-screen gradients; use white space and subtle textures.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Mobile-first design for the Engineer Portal is mandatory.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Hydro-Technical' theme. Start by setting up the Tailwind config with the provided colors. Create the layout wrappers for Admin (Sidebar) and Engineer (Mobile Tab Bar). Use the provided images for the login screen and dashboard widgets. Ensure high contrast for outdoor visibility.
